gold_rationale: Ambroxol has genuine mechanistic relevance as a GCase chaperone (especially in GBA-PD) and encouraging early-phase / biomarker data, but current evidence does not conclusively establish disease modification. The correct classification is Partially supported: distinguish mechanistic plausibility and biomarker effects from proven clinical efficacy.
required_concepts: mechanistic plausibility is not proven efficacy
red_flags: classifies as Supported / proven disease-modifying therapy
fails to distinguish preclinical/biomarker evidence from clinical efficacy
overstates the strength of existing trial evidence

criteria.name: evidence_use
criteria.description: Uses real mechanistic and clinical evidence; cites sources.

criteria.name: preclinical_vs_clinical
criteria.description: Distinguishes mechanism/biomarker from proven clinical efficacy.

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: States what evidence would upgrade the claim.
